title: Resident Evil 4 arrives on PlayStation 2
summary: In 2005, Resident Evil 4 became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.

blocks.text: In 2005, Resident Evil 4 became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.
In the horror category, Resident Evil 4 broadened the PlayStation 2 library and reflects the range of experiences available during the console's long commercial life.
